fields.description: One row per learner — this is the primary key, which is what makes the row a safe upsert target from a background job.
fields.label: User

fields.description: What separates the two leaderboards. A customer taking a handover course must never be ranked against the crew, nor the crew against them — this is the column that guarantees it, so it is derived on every save rather than typed.
fields.label: Learner Type

fields.description: Sum of the points on this learner's badge awards. Denormalised on purpose — a leaderboard that aggregates awards and completions on every page load is a table scan per viewer.
fields.label: Points

fields.description: Consecutive days with training activity. Falls back to zero when a day is missed, which is why the longest is kept separately.
fields.label: Current Streak

fields.description: The high-water mark. Never decreases — a streak somebody actually achieved is not taken away from them because they missed a Tuesday.
fields.label: Longest Streak

fields.description: Any training activity — a lesson watched counts, not only a course finished. This is what the streak is computed from.
fields.label: Last Activity
